title: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Oct. 19, 2026
total: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy’s deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Oct. 19, 2026, based on Navy and public data. In cases in which a CSG or ARG is conducting disaggregated operations, the chart reflects the location of the capital ship.

properties.name: In Japan
properties.said:
USS Tripoli (LHA-7) is in port in Sasebo, Japan.

Aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) arrived Friday and departed Monday from Yokosuka, Japan, according to ship spotters .

Carrier Strike Group 9 is composed of Theodore Roosevelt , Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 11, Destroyer Squadron 23, Information Warfare Squadron 9, and Ticonderoga-class guided-missile cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65).

properties.name: In the Pacific Ocean
properties.said:
Amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) is transiting the Pacific westward on deployment after a port visit to Hawaii.

The Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group includes Makin Island, USS Anchorage (LPD-23), USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26), and the embarked 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit.
